name: timestamp
description: A postmark on every reply - when the turn started and when it finished, in your own time zone, read from your machine and never guessed.

plugins.name: timestamp
plugins.description: Ends every reply with a small stamp box showing when the turn started and when it was finished, in your own time zone - read from a script on your machine, never guessed by the model. Installs the skill, plus a one-time /timestamp-setup command that writes the always-on rules file.
